env BOLERO_FLAGS='$(echo ''cc"''; echo ''OOPS="oops'')'
bolero env
[GOOS:darwin] stdout 'BOLERO_FLAGS=''\$\(echo ''\\''''cc"''\\''''; echo ''\\''''OOPS="oops''\\''''\)'''
[GOOS:linux] stdout 'BOLERO_FLAGS=''\$\(echo ''\\''''cc"''\\''''; echo ''\\''''OOPS="oops''\\''''\)'''
[GOOS:windows] stdout 'set BOLERO_FLAGS=\$\(echo ''cc"''; echo ''OOPS="oops''\)'
